text:
Maria: Quick sync — launching SI Mentor Pocket Guides next week. Need decision on localization priority and cert badge criteria.
Raj: 👍 Can we scope locales to EN, DE, and JP for V1?
Maria: EN + DE prioritized, JP conditional based on partner demand.
Noah: JP interest from two SIs, but their cohorts are small. Maybe JP as opt-in.
Liam: For distribution, think small PDF + Slack snippets + a short Loom. Less friction.
Susan: Agreed. Also want to confirm assessment format for the badges — quiz vs. practical lab?
Raj: Propose hybrid: 10-question quiz (auto) + one guided deploy lab (manual review). Pass both for full badge.
Susan: Sounds good. Proposed pass thresholds: quiz 80%, lab checklist 90%?
Noah: 80/90 ok. What about fast-track for partners with prior Redwood integrations?
Maria: Fast-track option: if they present a recent customer deployment + runbook, allow lab waiver but need a short oral review (15m).
OnboardBot: Reminder: SI Mentor Pocket Guide assets due in #marketing-assets by 2667890300.
Liam: Who owns translations? We can use partner-localization vendors or Redwood internal transcribers. Cost/tradeoffs?
Susan: Vendor quicker but costs. Internal gives tighter control over terminology (model names, config knobs). Suggest vendor for DE, internal for JP.
Raj: Landing page for certification metadata — I'll draft a JSON snippet for the console to consume: 
```json
{"module":"si-onboard","badge":"associate-si","quiz_pass":80,"lab_pass":90,"fast_track":true}
```
Maria: Perfect. Also we need human-readable FAQ: appeals, renewal cadence (12 months), revocation policy.
Noah: Renewal every 12 months makes sense. For revocation, require two failed audits or evidence of misconfiguration causing customer incidents.
Susan: Training schedule: 2-hour live instructor session + 4 self-paced micro-modules. Micro-modules should be <15 min each.
Liam: Will add Loom templates and code snippets for common deploy patterns. Example snippet for terraform provider block: 
```hcl
provider "redwood" {
  region = var.region
  api_key = var.redwood_api_key
}
```
Maria: Okay next steps: Raj to push draft console JSON + badge icon by EOD, Susan to finalize assessment rubrics, Liam to prepare asset templates, Noah to confirm fast-track checklist with SI leads. We'll reconvene Friday.
Noah: I'll ping the two JP partners to confirm interest.
Raj: Uploaded draft JSON to the shared drive: https://drive.example.com/si-pocket-guides/draft.json
Maria: Thanks — please react with :white_check_mark: when your action item is done.
OnboardBot: Certification pipeline created: si-pocket-guides-v1.0 — tasks assigned to Raj, Susan, Liam, Noah.
